name: M7.SignatureIdeal.monic_injective
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ F E : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial, F.Monic → E.Monic → F ∣ M6.Cyclic.modulus N → E ∣ M6.Cyclic.modulus N → (M7.SignatureIdeal.principal N F = M7.SignatureIdeal.principal N E ↔ F = E)
context:
theorem M7.SignatureIdeal.quotient_membership : ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ F p : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial, F ∣ M6.Cyclic.modulus N → (M6.Cyclic.image N p ∈ M7.SignatureIdeal.principal N F ↔ F ∣ p) := by
  change ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ F p : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial, F ∣ M6.Cyclic.modulus N → (M6.Cyclic.image N p ∈ M7.SignatureIdeal.principal N F ↔ F ∣ p)
  intro N inst F p hF
  change M6.Cyclic.image N p ∈ Ideal.span ({M6.Cyclic.image N F} : Set (M6.Cyclic.CycleRing N)) ↔ F ∣ p
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := AdjoinRoot.mk_surjective x
    subst x
    change AdjoinRoot.mk (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) p = AdjoinRoot.mk (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) F * AdjoinRoot.mk (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) q at hx
    have hz : AdjoinRoot.mk (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) (p - F * q) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, map_mul, hx, sub_self]
    have hd : M6.Cyclic.modulus N ∣ p - F * q := AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_zero.mp hz
    have hs : F ∣ (p - F * q) + F * q := dvd_add (hF.trans hd) (dvd_mul_right F q)
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hs
  · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨M6.Cyclic.image N q, ?_⟩
    change AdjoinRoot.mk (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) (F * q) = AdjoinRoot.mk (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) F * AdjoinRoot.mk (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) q
    exact map_mul _ _ _
guidance:
Use accepted M6.Cyclic.signature_bezout and signature_divides. Ideal.span_le and singleton membership/divisibility prove full_signature_ideal. For quotient_membership, a scalar witness in AdjoinRoot lifts to mk q by mk_surjective; mk equality implies modulus divides p-F*q, then F divides p. Conversely map a divisibility witness. monic_injective follows mutual divisibility and monicity. No squarefree/odd-N/irreducible quotient assumption; retain full polynomial multiplicities. This is ideal equality, not root-set equality. Return tactic lines only.
import M6CyclicAccepted

namespace M7.SignatureIdeal
noncomputable def principal (N : ℕ) (F : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial) : Ideal (M6.Cyclic.CycleRing N) :=
  Ideal.span ({M6.Cyclic.image N F} : Set (M6.Cyclic.CycleRing N))
noncomputable def pairIdeal (N : ℕ) (a b : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial) : Ideal (M6.Cyclic.CycleRing N) :=
  Ideal.span ({M6.Cyclic.image N a, M6.Cyclic.image N b} : Set (M6.Cyclic.CycleRing N))
end M7.SignatureIdeal
